zero_mad_audit.interpretation: The Lake Crescent zero-MAD failure mode did not recur in scoreable Lake Chelan strata.

primary_validation.reason: Predeclared coverage-stratum rule blocks the primary test when any frozen tile x radius stratum has candidates but zero scoreable candidate patches.

interpretation: A substantial preregistered bathymetry-to-backscatter enrichment signal transferred to the unseen Lake Chelan corpus and did so without the zero-MAD pathology seen in Lake Crescent. However, the frozen primary validation contract was not satisfied because stratum C|96 had no scoreable backscatter patches. The result is retained as strong unseen robustness evidence but not promoted to a formal validation PASS.
next_scientific_steps: Use Lake Chelan as calibration-only for any coverage-handling change learned from this result.
Run the unchanged dual-channel method on another unseen paired bathymetry/backscatter corpus with complete preregistered strata.
After this LC2 freeze, author-labeled Lake Chelan MTD polygons may be unlocked for descriptive natural-morphology recall with no retuning.
